hero.name: Maxime Danibert
hero.subtitle: Founder, entrepreneur and advisor
hero.intro1: I support early-stage entrepreneurs and companies in real estate (physical and proptech), data, technology and marketing, in Switzerland and internationally.
hero.intro2: My approach is pragmatic: hands-on experience, long-term thinking, and a multidisciplinary network built in Switzerland since 2008, which I am always happy to open when it makes sense.
hero.cta: Feel free to get in touch

about.title: About
about.p1: Entrepreneur based in Lausanne since 2008, I have founded four companies, raised over CHF 5 million, and built businesses across real estate, data, marketing, media and technology, with a strong focus on execution and simple, genuinely useful products.
about.p2: I help founders and small teams gain clarity, move faster and avoid costly mistakes in time, money and energy, many of which I have made myself over the past fifteen years.
about.p3: I also share reflections on real estate financing, particularly around structures such as viager (sale and leaseback) from an investor perspective, with a focus on ROE and optimising down payments.
about.p4: I am always open to discussing ideas, business models, product positioning and go-to-market challenges. I am also happy to connect the right people when it can create value.

approach.title: Approach
approach.p1: My approach is direct, pragmatic and discreet.
approach.p2: I do not believe in generic frameworks or unnecessary complexity.
approach.p3: Useful advice is grounded in real operational experience, clear thinking and honest conversations.

mentions.intro: Selected articles, interviews and public references.

privacyPolicy.pageDescription: Privacy Policy for the DANIBERT website.
privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy

sections.heading: 1. scope
sections.content:
This Privacy Policy explains how personal data are processed in connection with this website.

The website is intended to provide professional information and a contact channel.

sections.heading: 2. categories of personal data
sections.content:
The website may process the following categories of personal data:

  • identification data, such as your name
  • contact data, such as your email address
  • professional data you choose to provide, such as company name
  • message content submitted through the contact form
  • technical data generated when you access the website, such as IP address, browser type, device information, date and time of access, and basic server logs

sections.heading: 3. purposes of processing
sections.content:
Personal data may be processed for the following purposes:

  • to operate and secure the website
  • to receive, review and respond to enquiries
  • to prevent spam, abuse and fraudulent use
  • to protect legal interests and enforce rights
  • to maintain basic technical logs, security and system integrity

sections.heading: 4. legal basis
sections.content:
Where GDPR applies, processing is based, depending on the case, on one or more of the following grounds:

  • your consent
  • steps taken at your request before a potential contractual relationship
  • legitimate interests in operating a secure and functional professional website and handling relevant enquiries
  • compliance with legal obligations, where applicable

Under Swiss data protection law, personal data are processed in accordance with the applicable principles of lawfulness, good faith, proportionality, purpose limitation, transparency and data security.

sections.heading: 5. contact form
sections.content:
If you submit the contact form, the information you provide is used solely to assess and answer your message and, where relevant, continue the related exchange.

Providing the requested data is voluntary. However, mandatory fields are required in order to process your message.

sections.heading: 6. recipients and processors
sections.content:
Personal data may be disclosed only to service providers and technical processors strictly necessary for hosting, security, maintenance and communication, and only to the extent necessary for those purposes.

Personal data may also be disclosed where required by law, regulation, court order or legitimate legal process.

No sale of personal data takes place.

sections.heading: 7. international transfers
sections.content: If service providers process data outside Switzerland or the European Economic Area, reasonable steps should be taken to ensure an adequate level of protection, including contractual safeguards where required.

sections.heading: 8. retention
sections.content:
Personal data are retained only for as long as reasonably necessary for the purposes described above, including replying to enquiries, maintaining security records, complying with legal obligations, or establishing, exercising or defending legal claims.

Messages that do not lead to any relevant follow-up may be deleted after a reasonable period.

sections.heading: 9. security
sections.content:
Appropriate technical and organisational measures should be used to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, misuse, alteration or disclosure.

However, no internet transmission or storage system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

sections.heading: 10. cookies and similar technologies
sections.content:
This website is intended to operate with limited cookies and without unnecessary tracking.

If analytics, embedded third-party services, advertising technologies or additional cookies are implemented later, this Privacy Policy and any related consent mechanisms should be updated accordingly.

sections.heading: 11. external links and social media
sections.content: This website contains links to third-party websites and social media platforms. When you open those links, the data protection rules of the relevant third party apply.

sections.heading: 12. your rights
sections.content:
Subject to applicable law and the conditions of each regime, you may have the right to request access to your personal data, rectification of inaccurate data, deletion, restriction, objection, and, where applicable, data portability.

Where processing is based on consent, you may withdraw that consent for the future.

You may also have the right to lodge a complaint with a competent supervisory authority, including, where relevant, the Swiss Federal Data Protection and Information Commissioner.

sections.heading: 13. updates
sections.content: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time. The version published on the website at the time of consultation shall apply.

sections.heading: 14. contact
sections.content: For privacy-related requests concerning this website, please use the contact form available on the website.
